message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a central human figure and several large animals in a dense, jungle-like setting. At the top, the translucent grey text "TEMPO" is overlaid on dark foliage. Smaller white text reads "INDONESIALEAKS: SIASAT EKSPOR JURAGAN KAYU" and "GELIAT BARU KRAKATAU STEEL".

The human figure stands right of center, pointing left with their right arm. They wear a tan, long-sleeved shirt with pockets and hold a lit wooden torch in their left hand, casting a yellow-orange glow. Their face has an open-mouthed, shouting expression.

The foreground contains various animals: a large grey rhino head with a prominent horn at the bottom right, a brown orangutan holding a smaller infant at the bottom center, and a large panda with black and white markings at the left. A striped tiger faces right, positioned behind the rhino. In the background, the large, grey shape of an elephant is visible behind the human.

The text "MURKA MENTERI SITI" appears in large, bold white font. Below it, four lines of smaller white text detail environmental policy changes. Additional publication details, a barcode, and the date "3-9 FEBRUARI 2020" are at the bottom left.
